title: Estimated beetle species vs. total mammal and bird species

source.name: Global species estimates
source.publisher: Stork (2018), Annual Review of Entomology; IUCN / BirdLife International species counts

notes: Stork (2018) estimates roughly 1.5 million beetle species worldwide. There are about 6,400 described mammal species (IUCN / Mammal Diversity Database) and about 11,000 described bird species (BirdLife International). Beetles alone are estimated to far outnumber all mammal and bird species combined.
